subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: What public `skills.load` contract should OpenClaw expose for disabling built-in skill sources such as `agents-skills-personal`?
rationale: The source-level problem is clear, but adding config surface and changing built-in skill-source behavior is an operator-facing product/API choice under the repo's config-surface policy.

options.title: Add typed source disable list
options.body: Expose a backward-compatible enum-style setting such as `skills.load.disableSources` and make discovery, watcher targets, status, docs, and tests honor it for built-in skill roots.

options.title: Add narrow personal toggle
options.body: Expose only a personal `.agents/skills` toggle, minimizing API surface but leaving project-agent or future source controls to later decisions.

options.title: Reject source opt-out
options.body: Keep current source behavior and direct affected users to per-skill disables and prompt limits, accepting that large Claude Code skill directories remain noisy.

recommendation.title: Add typed source disable list
recommendation.body: Expose a backward-compatible enum-style setting such as `skills.load.disableSources` and make discovery, watcher targets, status, docs, and tests honor it for built-in skill roots.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-line blame and recent follow-up history put Vincent Koc closest to the present loader, watcher, and config files that would carry this decision.
